title: Where Waters Meet | KEY.co
meta_description: Walk to Beach + Private Pool in Seagrove
description_expanded: Inside, the thoughtfully designed living spaces are bathed in natural light, featuring an open-concept layout that invites relaxation and connection. A chef’s dream kitchen boasts a six-burner gas range, a stand-alone ice maker, a wine fridge, and both drip and Keurig coffee makers, making every meal a delight. Plush bedrooms promise restful nights, while spa-like bathrooms add a touch of indulgence. Outside, the beautifully landscaped backyard is an entertainer’s paradise, complete with a fire pit, corn hole, and twinkling café lights. A wrap-around porch and covered balcony provide the perfect spots to unwind, all while soaking in the peaceful views of Eastern Lake. Tucked away in the heart of Seagrove Beach, this elegantly renovated four-bedroom retreat captures the essence of coastal luxury. With a brand-new saltwater pool set to debut in February 2025, the home offers a seamless blend of modern comfort and laid-back beachside charm. Just a short stroll from the San Roy beach access, where the rare coastal dune lakes meet the Gulf, this prime location offers a stunning natural backdrop for unforgettable days by the water.

Features: There is free parking available for 5 vehicles.
Use of charcoal grills is not allowed.
